name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Canadian junior silver-gold developer focused on the Diablillos project, a large undeveloped silver-gold deposit located in Salta Province, northwestern Argentina. The company holds a 100% interest in Diablillos and has advanced the project through a preliminary feasibility study. It also trades on the OTCQX as ABBRF.
